basic_details.job_title: BGCL Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Online for 29 Assistant Associate, Associate & More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bengal Gas Company Limited (BGCL) has announced 29 vacancies for Assistant Associate (Project/O&M), Associate (Project/O&M), Sr. Associate (Project/O&M), Assistant Associate (Finance & Accounts), Associate (Finance & Accounts), Assistant Associate (C & P), Sr. Associate (Civil), Senior Associate (HR), Assistant Associate (BIS), Associate (BIS), Associate (GIS), Associate (CA) and 3 more posts on a contract basis. This fixed term employment is for a maximum period of 03 years with initial 06 months probation under advertisement number BGCL/OPEN/MISC/7/2026. Qualification requirements vary accor

how_to_apply: Visit the BGCL website at bgcl.co.in and click on the 'CAREERS' link, then select 'REGISTER HERE' to complete user registration with basic details.

Keep a valid email ID, mobile number, scanned self-attested recent passport-size color photograph (up to 200 KB in .JPG/.JPEG format), and scanned signature on white paper with black pen (up to 200 KB in .JPG/.JPEG format) ready.
Log in using registered credentials, go to Home > Dashboard, and view live advertisements in the 'Apply Section'.
Click 'Apply' to fill out the application form and provide ID proof documents in pdf/jpeg/jpg format (max size 200 KB).
Preview the application form carefully, as details cannot be edited after final submission.
Click the 'Submit' button for final submission and keep a printed copy of the online application form with the unique application number for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Total vacancies: 29. Category-wise and post-wise vacancy distribution is detailed below:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the educational qualification, experience, and age criteria specified for each post. Minimum required marks in graduation or professional degrees are generally 60% for technical roles and 50% for finance, management, or commerce roles, with relaxation for SC, ST, and PwBD category candidates. Assistant Associate (Project/O&M): Full Time Bachelor Degree in Engineering/Technology or B.Sc Engineering (04 years with minimum 60% marks) in Mechanical, Production, Production & Industrial, Manufacturing, Electrical, Electrical & Electronics, Instrumentation, Instrumentation & Control, Electronics & Instrumentation, Electrical & Instrumentation, Electronics, Electronics & Communication, or Electrical & Electronics, with minimum 03 years post qualification experience. Upper age limit: 37 years. Associate (Project/O&M): Engineering degree in specified branches with minimum 60% marks and minimum 06 years post qualification experience. Upper age limit: 41 years. Sr. Associate (Project/O&M): Engineering degree in specified branches with minimum 60% marks and minimum 09 years post qualification experience. Upper age limit: 50 years. Assistant Associate (Finance & Accounts): CA/ICWA/CMA with minimum 50% marks in final examination and Fellow/Associate membership of ICAI/ICWAI/ICMAI with minimum 01 year experience, OR two years full time MBA with Specialization in Finance with minimum 50% marks and 03 years experience, OR B.COM/M.COM with minimum 50% marks and 03 years experience. Upper age limit: 37 years. Associate (Finance & Accounts): CA/ICWA/CMA with minimum 50% marks and ICAI/ICWAI/ICMAI membership with minimum 03 years experience, OR MBA in Finance with 50% marks and 06 years experience, OR B.COM/M.COM with 50% marks and 06 years experience. Upper age limit: 41 years. Assistant Associate (C & P): Full time Bachelor Degree in Engineering/Technology or B.Sc Engineering (04 years) in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Instrumentation, Metallurgy, Civil, Production, IT, Computer Science, Electronics, Telecommunication, Industrial, or Petrochemical with minimum 60% marks OR full time MBA/PG Diploma in Management with specialization in Material Management, Supply Chain Management, Production Management, or Project Management with minimum 50% marks, plus 03 years experience. Upper age limit: 37 years. Sr. Associate (Civil): Full time Bachelor Degree in Engineering/Technology or B.Sc Engineering (04 years) in Civil with minimum 60% marks and minimum 09 years post qualification experience in Civil. Upper age limit: 50 years. Senior Associate (HR): Two years full time MBA/MMS/MSW with specialization in Human Resource Management, Personnel Management & Industrial Relations with minimum 50% marks OR full time Master Degree / PG Diploma in Personnel Management / Personnel Management & Industrial Relation with minimum 50% marks, plus minimum 09 years experience. Upper age limit: 50 years. Assistant Associate (BIS): Full time Bachelor Degree in Engi

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Positions are on Fixed Term Employment for a maximum period of 03 years with initial 06 months on probation. Consolidated monthly remuneration details are: Assistant Associate: Basic Pay Rs. 45,000, HRA Rs. 12,000, Other Allowances Rs. 8,000. Total Monthly Remuneration: Rs. 65,000. Associate: Basic Pay Rs. 55,000, HRA Rs. 15,000, Other Allowances Rs. 10,000. Total Monthly Remuneration: Rs. 80,000. Sr. Associate: Basic Pay Rs. 70,000, HRA Rs. 19,000, Other Allowances Rs. 11,000. Total Monthly Remuneration: Rs. 1,00,000. Other benefits include Provident Fund, Reimbursement of Medical Insurance for self, spouse, and first two children, Group Personal Accident Insurance, and Leave. First annual increment will be added after completion of one year from the date of joining subject to experience and caste verification, and second annual increment after one year thereafter.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Online applications will be screened based on notified eligibility criteria. Depending on the number of applicants, candidates may undergo a single-stage or multiple-stage selection process based on marks obtained in required qualifications and/or relevant post-qualification experience. The selection process will involve an interview before the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q1. Are these posts permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: These positions are on Fixed Term Employment for a maximum period of 03 years with an initial 06 months on probation, with no extension beyond three years.

faq.question: Q2. Are HRA and other allowances paid on top of the basic pay?
faq.answer: Yes, monthly total remuneration includes basic pay, HRA, and other allowances (conveyance and communication expenses) as specified for each designation level.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for age relaxations and how much is allowed?
faq.answer: Upper age is relaxable by 05 years for SC/ST candidates, 03 years for OBC (NCL) candidates, 10 years for PwBD-General/EWS, 13 years for PwBD-OBC (NCL), and 15 years for PwBD-SC/ST candidates, applicable to reserved posts or identified suitable posts.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the selection process?
faq.answer: Screening and selection are based on details provided in online applications, considering required qualifications and relevant post-qualification experience criteria, followed by an interview before the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q5. Can employed candidates apply, and what documents are required?
faq.answer: Candidates employed in Government Departments, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must forward their application through Proper Channel or produce an NOC at the time of the interview.
